description: Intelligence V1.27 pre-registered candidate/configuration registry (from the V1.26 shortlist). Identities are recorded only where currently verifiable without downloading a model: the baseline is fully pinned from local files (V1.23A); other candidates carry registry-observed manifest metadata and null local digests until an authorized pull verifies them. A pull whose model-layer digest differs from registryObserved halts the stage. Each candidate's license is recorded and must be acceptable for the intended use before any production adoption.
